approvedDesign:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: ONE cohesive art-directed sticker-pack preview sheet for the Chinese gecko social site GSM. This is a design review contact sheet, not a website screenshot. Completely redesign the rejected pixel-art pack in a beautiful SMOOTH NON-PIXEL hand-drawn cartoon sticker style.

Create exactly 25 different expressive stickers of ONE consistent adorable leopard gecko in a clean evenly spaced 5 by 5 grid on an almost-white warm cream background. Large portrait artboard, generous margins, each whole sticker isolated with breathing room. No card borders. Small understated title at top: "GSM · 守宫表情". A small neat Chinese reaction label below each sticker, exact labels specified below, no English IDs, no other text.

Character design: a charming small butter-yellow leopard gecko with a creamy belly, only a handful of warm brown oval spots on the head and back, soft blunt muzzle, wide slightly flattened head with protruding expressive eyes and visible eyelids, four short articulated legs with small splayed curved toes, a beautifully plump tapering tail with 2 or 3 subtle bands. Recognizably a GECKO, not a frog, dinosaur, crocodile, cat or human. Head at most 45% of silhouette. Mostly low quadrupedal poses; can raise front paws for gestures. No human clothes. Appealing tiny asymmetric mouth and strong eye acting, with deadpan and annoyed expressions as well as cute ones. Maintain identical anatomy, palette and outline language across all 25.

Style: polished independent illustrator's chat stickers, wonderfully simple fluid shapes, gently varied dark espresso outline with smooth rounded joins, precise smooth anti-aliased contours, flat warm cream and butter-yellow fills, discreet coral blush only where appropriate, tiny pale-blue tears. Very minimal soft shadow accents, no 3D rendering, no glossy plastic, no airbrush. Strong readable silhouettes and facial expressions at small size, intentional negative space. NOT pixel art, absolutely no square jagged edges, no pixel grid, no dithering. Not chibi human stance, not repetitive stamps with merely different faces. Sophisticated cute with dry humor.

Rows, left to right, exact Chinese labels:
1 "路过": relaxed four-legged stance, tiny side glance, thick tail curled; "啊？": raised head tilted in genuine confusion with one small question mark; "无语": eyes half closed, flat mouth, one forepaw at face; "气死": indignantly braced front paws, head puffed, tail lifted, small anger mark; "呜呜": slumped gecko with big falling tears, no huge distracting puddle.
2 "笑翻": gecko rolled onto its side belly visible, laughing with shut crescent eyes and paws curled; "吃瓜": sitting low, forepaws hold small watermelon wedge, attentive eyes; "趴平": fully flattened pancake-like body with chin down and limbs spread, tail relaxed; "收到": one forepaw raised in a small affirmative wave, bright alert eyes; "不信": skeptical one eyelid lowered, head turned, one paw under chin.
3 "嫌弃": recoiling neck and torso, one forepaw held away, displeased narrowed eyes; "呵呵": tiny smug sideways smile, raised chin, smug closed eyelids; "急了": leaning forward over planted forepaws, tense eyes, tail bristling upward with two tiny exclamation marks; "拍爪": raised front paws clapping with a small motion arc, pleased eyes; "掀垫": dramatic gecko flings a small rectangular beige basking mat into air with front paws, tail counterbalances.
4 "憋住": paws over tiny mouth, cheeks puffed, tense amused eyes; "懒得回": turning back toward viewer with over-shoulder bored glance, tail wrapped around feet; "流汗": sheepish expression with one blue sweat drop; "心虚": looking away, toes touching nervously, body crouched low; "装死": flat on back belly-up, four curled paws lifted, funny tiny x eyes, thick tail flopped.
5 "宕机": bewildered vacant stare, lightly crooked head with tiny wavy symbol above it; "探头": only head and one front paw peeking from behind a small simple pale stone at side, visible curved tail; "蹲后续": low perched crouch, chin resting on folded front paws, eyes attentively watching; "求求": pleading shiny eyes, two tiny front paws pressed together below chin, no praying human body; "溜了": dynamic low gecko scampering away, looking back, sweeping thick tail and two motion strokes.

Balance the pack so every pose is different and every expression is readable, with clear complete tails and no cropped toes. Aim for a lovable, mischievous internet gecko, expressive beyond mere sweetness. The lettering should be clean, small, consistent and legible; the drawings are the focus.
transparentAtlas:
Use case: background-extraction.
Edit the supplied APPROVED GSM gecko sticker sheet into a production transparent sprite atlas.
Preserve the exact approved hand-drawn character designs, poses, facial expressions, warm yellow colors, espresso outlines, spots, props, motion marks, and style of ALL TWENTY-FIVE individual drawings. This is a careful extraction and layout task, NOT a redesign. Do not invent alternative poses, and do not simplify or pixelate the art.
Remove the title, every Chinese label, the cream paper background and ground shadows. The space around each actual drawing must be genuinely transparent alpha, not white and not a simulated checkerboard. Pale cream interior areas of the geckos must remain opaque and intact, as must eyes, tails, limbs, the watermelon, stone and mat.
Arrange the 25 extracted drawings in exactly the SAME row-major sequence on a SQUARE transparent atlas: five perfectly equal rows and five perfectly equal columns. Each drawing centered in its own equal square cell, fitting inside the middle 84% of the cell, leaving generous empty transparent margins on every side. No drawing or motion mark may cross its cell border. Consistent apparent character scale, while respecting wide and tall poses. Keep all 25. No labels, no typography, no grid lines, no frames, no watermark.
Exact sequence:
Row 1 relaxed side-glance gecko / puzzled looking upward with question mark / bored chin-on-paw gecko / angry braced gecko with anger mark / crying flattened gecko.
Row 2 laughing rolled-on-side gecko / watermelon-eating gecko / completely flattened sleepy gecko / happy one-paw wave / skeptical chin-on-paw gecko.
Row 3 recoiling disgust with paw extended / smug closed-eyed gecko / angry forward-leaning gecko with exclamations / clapping gecko / gecko flipping a small basking mat.
Row 4 paws-over-mouth holding laughter / back turned with bored look over shoulder / sweating sheepish gecko / nervous crouched gecko / belly-up play-dead gecko.
Row 5 vacant confused gecko with squiggle / gecko peeking from a stone / crouched gecko waiting chin on folded paws / pleading gecko paws together / scampering away looking back.
Keep smooth high-quality anti-aliased edges and real transparency.
